appliesTo: every endpoint in scope that requires authentication

checks.name: malformed Authorization header (wrong scheme, empty token)
token whose claims were edited (e.g. role changed) without re-signing
expired token (issue one with the app's own signing path and a past expiry where the test setup allows, otherwise skip)
token of a user deleted or deactivated after it was issued
token reused after logout, when the app documents server-side logout
login with wrong password repeated
checks.expect: 401 each time; same message as unknown email (no account enumeration)

pass: Every check gets the expected status and no data from the protected resource.
fail: Any protected data returned, or a 5xx.
fix: Verify signatures with a pinned algorithm list, check expiry, reload the user on each request, and return the same error for unknown user and wrong password.
